mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 900K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 900K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 7%, indicating a strong labor market, it boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX returns in late-cycle expansions with UNRATE < 7% are not significantly higher than in other regimes (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain strength, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but requires concurrent low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this joint condition remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, indicating robust demand, directly translates to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, without any additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX returns when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% YoY are not significantly higher than baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a month, signaling aggressive monetary easing, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:impact of rate cuts on equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances following such rate cuts.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 8%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS growth > 1% MoM) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it indicates a strong labor market driving economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this joint labor condition remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer demand, directly correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this relationship is more pronounced during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: The difference in SPX returns between late-cycle and other regimes when RSAFS growth exceeds 5% YoY is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.1).
